103:## Round 5d: collapsible medication list in the patient chart (owner request 2026-11-02)
105:C500. In `WorkspaceScreen.kt`, section MEDICATIONS: each `MedicationCard` can collapse. Collapsed shows ONE row: name, status badge, and a single-line summary "dose · frequency" (skip empty parts), plus the edit pencil when editing is allowed. Expanded shows today's full card unchanged.
106:C501. The whole collapsed row is the toggle (tag `medicationToggle-<id>`, 48 dp minimum, chevron icon up/down, content description from new strings "Show details"/"Hide details"). The edit pencil keeps tag `editMedication-<id>` and works while collapsed.
107:C502. Default: expanded when the patient has 3 or fewer medications; all collapsed when more than 3. Per-card state is `rememberSaveable` keyed on the medication id. Existing tag `medication-<id>` stays on the card in both states.
108:C503. Above the list, when there are more than 3 medications, one text button tagged `medicationsToggleAll` ("Collapse all"/"Expand all") that sets every card; the state is one place (a rememberSaveable set of expanded ids) used by the cards and this button.
109:C504. Summary text is one line (maxLines=1, ellipsis not allowed for name+status: shorten by dropping the summary first); 48 dp targets; theme colours; works at 160% font; English; new strings only for the four labels above, defined once.
110:S230 WorkspaceScreen.kt carries tags `medicationToggle-`, `medicationsToggleAll`, `medication-`, `editMedication-`. S231 strings.xml defines the four new labels once. S232 no model/state/storage file changed against HEAD.
111:T500 With 2 medications both cards show full details (a FactRow label such as Dosage visible). T501 With 4 medications all are collapsed (no Dosage label), the toggle-all button exists; tapping `medicationToggle-<id>` expands only that card. T502 Tapping `medicationsToggleAll` expands all, tapping it again collapses all. T503 `editMedication-<id>` exists and is displayed while collapsed.

2304	@Composable
2305	private fun CollapsedMedicationRow(
2306	    name: String,
2307	    status: String,
2308	    summaryText: String,
2309	    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
2310	) {
2311	    Layout(
2312	        modifier = modifier,
2313	        content = {
2314	            Icon(
2315	                imageVector = Icons.Default.KeyboardArrowDown,
2316	                contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.show_details),
2317	                tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
2318	                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp),
2319	            )
2320	            Text(
2321	                text = name,
2322	                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
2323	                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
2324	                maxLines = 1,
2325	            )
2326	            MedicationStatusBadge(status)
2327	            if (summaryText.isNotBlank()) {
2328	                Text(
2329	                    text = summaryText,
2330	                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
2331	                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
2332	                    maxLines = 1,
2333	                )
2334	            }
2335	        },
2336	    ) { measurables, constraints ->
2337	        val spacing = 8.dp.roundToPx()
2338	        val chevronPlaceable = measurables[0].measure(Constraints())
2339	        val namePlaceable = measurables[1].measure(Constraints())
2340	        val badgePlaceable = measurables[2].measure(Constraints())
2341	
2342	        val fixedWidth = chevronPlaceable.width + spacing + namePlaceable.width + spacing + badgePlaceable.width
2343	        val hasSummary = measurables.size > 3
2344	        val summaryPlaceable = if (hasSummary) {
2345	            val unconstrained = measurables[3].measure(Constraints())
2346	            val availForSummary = constraints.maxWidth - fixedWidth - spacing
2347	            if (availForSummary > 0 && unconstrained.width <= availForSummary) {
2348	                unconstrained
2349	            } else {
2350	                null
2351	            }
2352	        } else {
2353	            null
2354	        }
2355	
2356	        val totalWidth = if (summaryPlaceable != null) {
2357	            fixedWidth + spacing + summaryPlaceable.width
2358	        } else {
2359	            fixedWidth
2360	        }
2361	        val height = maxOf(
2362	            chevronPlaceable.height,
2363	            namePlaceable.height,
2364	            badgePlaceable.height,
2365	            summaryPlaceable?.height ?: 0,
2366	        )
2367	
2368	        layout(totalWidth.coerceAtMost(constraints.maxWidth), height) {
2369	            var x = 0
2370	            chevronPlaceable.placeRelative(x, (height - chevronPlaceable.height) / 2)
2371	            x += chevronPlaceable.width + spacing
2372	            namePlaceable.placeRelative(x, (height - namePlaceable.height) / 2)
2373	            x += namePlaceable.width + spacing
2374	            badgePlaceable.placeRelative(x, (height - badgePlaceable.height) / 2)
2375	            if (summaryPlaceable != null) {
2376	                x += badgePlaceable.width + spacing
2377	                summaryPlaceable.placeRelative(x, (height - summaryPlaceable.height) / 2)
2378	            }
2379	        }

content.text:
I've read the spec and the medication code, and I'm writing up the review now. I couldn't run `git diff` because I only have read tools. I checked the current file against the spec, not against HEAD.

**Round 5d review (WorkspaceScreen.kt, strings.xml)**

**Hard Blocker**
- None found. The tags, the 3-or-fewer default, the single state set and the edit event path all match C500–C503. The edit callback is unchanged: `onEditMedication(med)` still sends `StartMedicationEditor` with `medicationId = med.id`.

**Should-fix**
1. **State is reset when the medication list changes.** `rememberSaveable(patient.id, medications.map { it.id }.joinToString(","), ...)` (line 2145–2148) puts the whole id list in the key. Adding or removing one medication wipes every card's expanded state, and the default is applied again. A patient who goes from 3 to 4 medications gets all cards collapsed, losing the doctor's open cards. C502 says the state is keyed on the medication id. Key on `patient.id` only. The state is already a set of ids, so stale ids are harmless. The default would then apply only on first composition.
2. **Name, badge or both can be clipped at 160% font.** In `CollapsedMedicationRow` (line 2338–2342) the name and badge are measured with `Constraints()`, which is unconstrained. `layout(totalWidth.coerceAtMost(constraints.maxWidth), ...)` then caps the width. A long drug name plus the badge is wider than the row, so the badge is pushed past the edge and clipped. `maxLines = 1` has no effect there. C504 requires name and status to stay visible and only the summary to be dropped. Measure the name with `maxWidth - chevron - badge - 2*spacing`, or use a plain `Row` with `Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false)` on the name. The plain `Row` would also replace the custom `Layout`, which is heavy for this.
3. **Touch-target helper not reused.** `.defaultMinSize(minHeight = 48.dp)` appears twice, at lines 2269 and 2275. The brief says to reuse `minimumTouchTarget()`. The Box and the Row also both set a minimum, so one is redundant. Keep `minimumTouchTarget()` on the Box only.

**Nit**
- Line 2239: the expanded name `Text(med.name, ...)` has no `maxLines`. This is fine for the unchanged full card. I'm noting it only because the collapsed name does have one.
- Line 2280: `end = if (canEdit) 52.dp else 16.dp` is a hard-coded magic number tied to `IconButton`'s 48 dp. Add a comment or derive it. It is not a colour or string, so it isn't a blocker.
- `PencilEditButton` wraps itself in `Row(fillMaxWidth)` (line 2418). In the collapsed Box that Row overlays the toggle row. It doesn't consume taps, so it works. Check this on a device.
- The chevron `Icon` carries the "Show details" and "Hide details" content description inside a clickable Row. Make sure the merged semantics expose it, or put the description on the Row. This is not verified.

**Checked and fine**
- **Strings and colours:** the four strings are defined once (strings.xml 397–400). The code uses theme colours only, with no hard-coded colours.
- **Single source of truth:** the toggle-all button and the cards share `expandedIds`. `allExpanded` is derived from it, not stored separately.
- **Default:** `size <= 3` expands all, and the toggle-all button only appears when `size > 3`.
- **Tags:** `medication-<id>` is on the Card in both states. `editMedication-<id>` is present in both states. `medicationToggle-<id>` and `medicationsToggleAll` are present.
- **Imports:** `Layout`, `Constraints`, `listSaver`, `defaultMinSize`, `KeyboardArrowUp`, `KeyboardArrowDown` and `TextButton` are all imported.
- **Dead code:** none seen. `StringSetSaver` is used.
- **Scope:** I only looked at WorkspaceScreen.kt and strings.xml. I could not confirm that model/, state/ and storage/ are untouched (S232).

**Not verified**
- The expanded card's fields, tags and `isNonCompliant` handling against HEAD. They look the same as the spec's "unchanged" card, but I had no diff.
- No tests were run. `MedicationListCollapseTest.kt` exists under androidTest, and I didn't execute it.

C504 requires name and status to stay visible and only the summary to be dropped. Measure the name with `maxWidth - chevron - badge - 2*spacing`, or use a plain `Row` with `Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false)` on the name. The plain `Row` would also replace the custom `Layout`, which is heavy for this.
3. **Touch-target helper not reused.** `.defaultMinSize(minHeight = 48.dp)` appears twice, at lines 2269 and 2275. The brief says to reuse `minimumTouchTarget()`. The Box and the Row also both set a minimum, so one is redundant. Keep `minimumTouchTarget()` on the Box only.
